text: Lighting is the most important factor when it comes to photography. You want the light to be soft, so that the subject will be able to shine through. This is the most difficult thing to accomplish and the most important one. You have to be very careful when you set up your tripod. Too much tension in the legs can cause the legs to bind, and tripod legs that are too light can be hard to move. If you look closely at your tripod, you will notice that there is something under the base plate. This is the tripod leg. You can use this leg to lower the camera and tripod. This is the most important thing to remember when you are photographing.
